title: Chipotle Lime Marinade
steps: Whisk everything together. Set aside 2 tbsp for brushing later.
Add the chicken, turn to coat, cover or seal in a zip-top bag and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 4 hours. The lime softens the surface if left longer.
## Bake: on a rack, pan lined
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a sheet pan with foil (the honey and adobo drips scorch on bare metal) and set a wire rack on top.

Place the chicken on the rack and bake: bone-in thighs or drumsticks 35–45 min, boneless breast 18–24 min. Brush with the reserved marinade for the last 5 minutes. Done at 165°F (74°C) for breast, 175°F (79°C) or more for thighs and drumsticks. Rest 5 minutes.
Grill over high heat for char, moving to a cooler spot if it flares up.
Never reuse marinade that has touched raw chicken. For basting or sauce, set some aside before adding the chicken.
